{{2014–15 ACC men's basketball standings}}
The '''2014–15 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Boston College]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Eagles, led by first year head coach [[Jim Christian]], played their home games at [[Conte Forum]] and were members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 13–19, 4–14 in ACC play to finish in 13th place. They advanced to the second round of the [[2014 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] where they lost to North Carolina.

==Last season==
The [[2013–14 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the season 8–24, 4–14 in ACC play to finish in 14th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2014 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to Georgia Tech.
